data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 1,023,000. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded an increase in gross prior year provisions of GBP 52,000 (adverse/prior-year strengthening), representing approximately 5.09% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The movement is presented in the Technical Provisions note as 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions'.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts were reported in the accounts in GBP 000 and converted to millions. Opening reserves (1,023) and the prior-year movement (52) are taken from the Balance Sheet (Liabilities) and Technical Provisions note respectively. The prior year movement is the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' row in the Technical Provisions table. No explicit narrative explanation or named events tied to this movement was provided. Gross premiums written for 2024 are negative (reflecting runoff adjustments) as reported.
